architectures.note: Do not replace target evidence with local proxy.

architectures.mechanism: same canonical closure predicate as CCW + persisted immutable DONE receipt guarded by trigger + REENTERED/DONE allowed in one transaction
same canonical support rows + read-only causal closure view; no DONE receipt table

fault_control: Inject fault after REENTERED/reentry writes but before DONE insert while conventional baseline uses one explicit transaction; rollback must remove partial terminal state.
invalidation_control: After valid conventional receipt exists, invalidate one support fact. Compare receipt existence with freshly derived closure.
writability_control: Attempt direct INSERT into CCW SQLite view; it must fail unless an INSTEAD OF trigger is deliberately added.
